summary: Tested financial dashboard stability after iteration_154 fix. Backend APIs working correctly (200 OK, correct data). Frontend has intermittent data display issue - sometimes shows correct values, sometimes shows zeros despite API returning correct data.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent data display - values show zeros despite API returning correct data. Loading state banner remains visible even after data should have loaded. Issue is not consistent - sometimes data loads correctly after 15-20 seconds, other times it never loads.

integration_issues.issue: React Query state management issue - API returns 200 OK with correct data but UI sometimes doesn't update. The coreLoading state remains true and data shows zeros. This appears to be a timing/caching issue with React Query.

action_items: Investigate React Query caching/state management issue in ComprehensiveFinancial.jsx
The ensureSuccessResponse and hasCoreError fixes are working correctly - API errors are handled properly
The issue is that successful API responses are not always updating the UI state
Consider adding staleTime: 0 or refetchOnMount: 'always' to the useQuery options
Check if placeholderData is interfering with the data update

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: React Query state management issue - the useQuery hooks are not consistently updating the UI when API data arrives
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe that values show zeros despite API returning 200 OK with correct data
4. Sometimes data loads after 15-20 seconds, sometimes it never loads
5. Clicking refresh button sometimes helps, sometimes doesn't
potential_fixes: Add staleTime: 0 to useQuery options to prevent stale data
Add refetchOnMount: 'always' to force refetch on component mount
Remove placeholderData option which may be interfering with updates
Add explicit refetch call after component mounts
